packages.name: undici
packages.evidence: node_modules/undici 7.29.1 (lockfile dev) is in e.g. GHSA-4qv8-2p9j-2685 >=7.0.0 <7.30.1. Its dependents are node_modules/miniflare (root devDependency) and node_modules/wrangler/node_modules/miniflare (wrangler devDependency). Not D1 (miniflare/wrangler are not in D1's lists). For D2: no Dockerfile; no start script; build is 'tsc --noEmit && vite build' with prebuild 'node scripts/content.mjs && node scripts/foundation-revision-content.mjs', none reaching wrangler/miniflare; miniflare is imported only by scripts/*.test.mjs (tests); wrangler only in non-P5/P6 scripts (worker:check etc.). BUT workers/tutor/wrangler.jsonc:2, workers/assessment/wrangler.jsonc:2 and workers/reminders/wrangler.jsonc:2 hold "$schema": "../../node_modules/wrangler/config-schema.json". Section 2 counts 'a node_modules/<package> path in ... a build tool's configuration' as an import; wrangler bundles and deploys these Workers (README: Workers deployed with wrangler deploy), so wrangler.jsonc is arguably a build tool's configuration, which would make wrangler production (P1) and undici production via wrangler -> node_modules/wrangler/node_modules/miniflare -> node_modules/undici. If 'build tool's configuration' means only the P2-listed files (wrangler is not listed, .jsonc is not a source extension), D2 holds. I cannot decide which reading applies, so undecidable.

packages.name: fast-copy
packages.evidence: node_modules/fast-copy 4.0.4 (lockfile dev) is in GHSA-jggr-w7fw-pc2j >=4.0.0 <4.1.0 (OSV confirms 4.0.0-4.1.0). Its only dependent is node_modules/pino-pretty, declared in server/package.json devDependencies (not D1). server/package.json 'start': 'node dist/index.js' runs the server; server/src/interaction.ts:100-108 configures the Fastify logger with transport { target: 'pino-pretty' } whenever process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production', and the start script does not set NODE_ENV, so the start command loads pino-pretty through pino's transport hand-off; fast-copy is a declared dependency of that pino-pretty copy (following). Likewise desktop/package.json 'start': 'npm run build && electron .' runs Electron (P4) on desktop/dist, which depends on @z-wiki/server; desktop/src/env.ts:20-22 says the unpackaged dev form keeps NODE_ENV unset so pino-pretty is loaded. So D2 is not shown (a production command runs it through a package it hands off to). Caveat for the worker: the string target is not an 'import' under section 2's definition and pino has no peerDependenciesMeta for pino-pretty, so the split's mechanical P5 reading (bin name / first word) does not catch it; I rely on section 1 'What the start script ... uses' and section 2 (d) 'a start script counts whatever it runs'.
